llm.summary: The skill is a coherent Telegram-based body measurement workflow, but users should treat uploaded body videos and measurements as sensitive personal data.

dimensions.detail: Use of Telegram, an AnthroVision backend, API credentials, and optional exec capability is purpose-aligned, but the data involved is sensitive and privacy terms should be verified before use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with no executable bundled files or install scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly limits use to single scans and includes consent and local/private URL restrictions, though its generic create/query/modify/delete wording is broader than the actual described workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill says the free version does not save history and requires consent for scanning others, but it does not fully specify backend or Telegram retention and deletion guarantees.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The requested inputs, Telegram submission, scan polling, and returned body measurements match the stated personal body-scan purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending body videos and measurements through Telegram and the scanning backend. Confirm the provider's privacy policy, retention/deletion practices, and consent process, especially before uploading anyone else's video.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The concern is partially supported because the skill handles sensitive body videos and measurements, but the artifact does disclose Telegram/backend handling, consent requirements, private URL rejection, and no history feature; this supports user guidance rather than a Review verdict.
